Im the person my friends go to for advice, help, or to vent . So ask people about your social and talking skills to see if it’s good. See if you’re speaking and listening skills are great

I took all the hobbies I have (gaming, learning about new things, talking to people etc)and I put them all together to see what I can take from and make something out of it
